title: Conditional κ = 0.00308534 (+3.45e-6 over #5580): P104 three-stage commuting-contact cascade
body:
## Summary

This package (`research/p104-commuting-contact/`) resolves the open reordered-contact and fixed-contact-ceiling questions of [PR #5580](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5580) (`research/p104-event-contact-step`) and [PR #5590](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5590) (`research/p104-fixed-contact-ceiling`) on the P104 word and certifies **conditional κ = 0.00308534** (tested at `0.0030853405`), up from `0.00308189` in [PR #5580](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5580) and `0.00308181` in [PR #5569](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5569).

- **Headline word (`WORD.json.gz`, Stage A + Stage B + Stage C):** Exact raw crossing lies in **`(0.00308534541177, 0.00308534541178)`**, a raw gain of **`+3.45044310e-6 to +3.45044312e-6`** over PR #5580's `(0.00308189496866, 0.00308189496867)`. Complete paid calls drop by **108** (`66,852 -> 66,744`), local `MOVE` instructions drop by `6` per call and scalar `ADD` operations drop by `1` per call (`25,140 -> 25,133` events), while all 208 main endpoints, 12,814 productive fields, rank-mass surplus `760`, and all eight owned lifetimes remain unchanged.
- **Fixed-endpoint supporting word (`WORD-FIXED-ENDPOINTS.json.gz`, Stage A only):** Retains **all 735 `initial` and `final` frames and all 527 helper targets** identical to PR #5580 (`local['helpers'] == parent_local['helpers']`), reducing complete paid calls by **72** (`66,852 -> 66,780`) with local paid delta `-4 H1 - 4 H4 + 4 H5` and raising the raw crossing to **`(0.00308415555080, 0.00308415555081)`** (`+2.26058214e-6` over PR #5580, certifying **κ = 0.00308415**).

[Proof](https://github.com/hexapode/integer-mult-bounds/blob/691c1b0aacce32275f286dce1e354d5839ad0b22/research/p104-commuting-contact/PROOF.md) · [Complete receipt](https://github.com/hexapode/integer-mult-bounds/blob/691c1b0aacce32275f286dce1e354d5839ad0b22/research/p104-commuting-contact/RESULT.json) · [Source pins](https://github.com/hexapode/integer-mult-bounds/blob/691c1b0aacce32275f286dce1e354d5839ad0b22/research/p104-commuting-contact/SOURCES.json) · [Construction](https://github.com/hexapode/integer-mult-bounds/blob/691c1b0aacce32275f286dce1e354d5839ad0b22/research/p104-commuting-contact/construct.py) · [Validation](https://github.com/hexapode/integer-mult-bounds/blob/691c1b0aacce32275f286dce1e354d5839ad0b22/research/p104-commuting-contact/VALIDATION.md)

---

## Mathematical Mechanism

PR #5561, PR #5569, PR #5580, and PR #5590 kept the linear execution order and instruction set of the 21,686 scalar operations from PR #5551 fixed. Reordering commuting `ADD` writes (Stages A and B) and commuting a triangular uncompute addition across a nested subspace chain (Stage C) yields three composable improvements:

1. **Stage A (`WORD-FIXED-ENDPOINTS.json.gz`, fixed helper endpoints, `-4 H1 - 4 H4 + 4 H5` locally):**
   - Between `13528` and `13634`, main port `198` receives only `ADD` writes (`13529: ADD 198, 710, 2` and `13625, 13628, 13631, 13634: ADD 198, 648/649/650/652, ±1/2`), and helpers `648, 649, 650, 652` are in their initial read-only epoch at chart `3` (`0D`).
   - Commuting `13625, 13628, 13631, 13634` before `13528: ['MOVE', 198, 3, 597, False]` to chart `3` (`0D`) vacates chart `597` (`1D`) on all four helpers `648, 649, 650, 652`, collapsing each itinerary `3 (0D) -> 597 (1D) -> 120 (5D)` (`H1 + H4`) into a single direct transport `3 (0D) -> 120 (5D)` (`H5`).

2. **Stage B (Domino cascade on `113, 531, 197, 319, 507`, `-4 H1 - H3 + 2 H4` paid and `-H8 + H9` target locally):**
   - Commuting `13806: ['ADD', 113, 531, '1']` before `13524: ['MOVE', 113, 3, 597, False]` to chart `3` (`0D`) allows all three initial read contacts of helper `531` (`13806` with `113`, `13843` with `197`, and `14404` with `507`) to execute at chart `3` (`0D`) with `initial[531] = 3`.
   - Because `197` stays at `3` (`0D`) after `13843` instead of climbing to `597` (`[82]`), its next contact `13846: ['ADD', 197, 319, '1']` demotes from 3-plane `617` (`[30, 44, 76]`) to 2-plane `355` (`[30, 44]`), vacating `617` on both `197` (`3 -> 355 -> 788`, `H2 + H3` instead of `H1 + 2 H2`) and `319` (`355 -> 728`, `H2` instead of `2 H1`), while `507` climbs directly `3 -> 728` (`H4` instead of `H1 + H3`) and `531` climbs `3 -> 741` (`H4` instead of `H3`, with helper credit `H8 -> H9`).

3. **Stage C (`WORD.json.gz`, triangular uncompute commutation on `341, 345, 712`, `+2 H1 - H7` paid and `+H4 - H9` target locally):**
   - Helper `341` completes all lower-dimensional work at event `11161` in 4-plane `240` (`[13, 19, 70, 416]`), where `row(341)|_11161 = - 341 + row(345)|_11066`, and is never read again.
   - In PR #5580, `341` jumped `240 (4D) -> 127 (9D)` (`16652`) only to execute `16654: 341 += -345`, `16655: 341 *= -1`, and `16915: 341 += 4 * 712`, because `345` added `-4 * row(712)` at `13569` (for readers `170` at `13809` and `347` at `14444` in 3-plane `739`) before uncomputing `16920: 345 += 4 * 712` after `16654`.
   - Because `span(391) (2D, [30, 491]) ⊂ span(739) (3D, [30, 70, 429]) ⊂ span(240) (4D, [13, 19, 70, 416]) ⊂ span(127) (9D)`, commuting `16920: 345 += 4 * 712` before `16654: 341 += -345` to chart `739` (`3D`) immediately after `14444` cancels `16915: 341 += 4 * 712` identically by transitivity of `ADD` (`-1` scalar `ADD`), demotes `16654` and `16655` to chart `240` (`4D`), deletes `16652: MOVE 341: 240 -> 127` (`-H5`), and retires `341` at `final[341] = 240` (`4D` instead of `9D`, target `+H4 - H9`), while `345` climbs `739 -> 240 -> 127` (`H1 + H5 - H6`) and `712` climbs `391 -> 739 -> 127` (`H1 + H6 - H7`).

| Word | Paid calls | Local paid delta vs #5580 | Local target delta | Raw crossing interval | Claimed κ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| PR #5580 (`p104-event-contact-step`) | `66,852` | baseline | baseline | `(0.00308189496866, 0.00308189496867)` | `0.00308189` |
| Stage A (`WORD-FIXED-ENDPOINTS.json.gz`) | `66,780` | `-4 H1 - 4 H4 + 4 H5` | `0` (all 735 endpoints fixed) | `(0.00308415555080, 0.00308415555081)` | `0.00308415` |
| Stage A+B (intermediate cascade) | `66,726` | `-8 H1 - H3 - 2 H4 + 4 H5` | `-H8 + H9` (`initial[531]: 597 -> 3`) | `(0.00308521055201, 0.00308521055202)` | `0.00308520` |
| Stage A+B+C (`WORD.json.gz`, headline) | `66,744` | `-6 H1 - H3 - 2 H4 + 4 H5 - H7` | `+H4 - H8` (`final[341]: 127 -> 240`) | `(0.00308534541177, 0.00308534541178)` | **`0.00308534`** |

---

## Verification

Standard-library Python 3.10+ suffices; no external solver is required:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-commuting-contact
```

Expected markers are `PASS_P104_COMMUTING_CONTACT_KAPPA_00308534` in both normal and `-O` modes and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.
